# Security reports

Use this repository's private vulnerability reporting channel for security
issues. Provide a minimal synthetic reproduction and affected app/OS versions.
Keep private keys, tokens, personal study records and full real-library backups
out of public reports.

Important boundaries include plain-text imported content, native picker/export-ID
file access, atomic library writes/restores, scoped Tauri capabilities, and signed
version-bound updates. A published updater signature is distinct from Windows
publisher identity or Apple notarization.

Security, runtime, engine and workflow changes receive review and the required
checks. Report actual testing accurately; automated accessibility checks do not
establish human screen-reader results.
